interfaces.name: neck_horn
interfaces.what: D17.0 x 1.0 raised disc on a D16.9 x 2.3 plate at the front-top corner, carrying the XL330 horn relief pocket and 4 x D2.2 on a D12 PCD (holes at y/z offsets (+6,0)(-6,0)(0,+6)(0,-6) from (-22,50)) - the neck-pitch joint axis (MJCF neck_pitch at world y=14.5) runs along -x through this face
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's left_shell.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and meshslice.loops, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: base_screw
interfaces.what: D8 vertical boss at the front-outboard corner: D2.2 pilot z 40.58..42.5 tapped by an M2 driven from below, D5.06 driver-access bore continuing up through the top skin
interfaces.source: MEASURED: meshfeatures hole D2.2 axis z at (25.5,-9.5,41.53) len 1.94; bore D5.06 from y-spans at z=45; boss D8 from x-spans at z=45

interfaces.name: cross_screw
interfaces.what: the cross screw that closes the two shell halves: D2.2 clearance x 0..2, drafted D3.5..4.4 driver bore from the outboard wall; mates the right shell's D1.6 tapped boss at its x 0.3..5.0 (M2 self-tapping). The left half also carries the 1.0 mm lap strip (x -1.95..0.05, the inner half of the walls) that registers the halves
interfaces.source: MEASURED: meshfeatures holes D2.2 at (1.0,42,52.5) len 2.0 (left) and D1.6 at (-2.65,42,52.5) len 4.7 (right); bore taper from z@42 spans at x=2.5..27

interfaces.name: base_ledge
interfaces.what: the 2.25 mm foot at the back-bottom (x 20..28.6, y 23..44, bottom z = 17.23 + 0.04x) that the shell stands on inside the trunk; the mating part is not identified (CANNOT DETERMINE which trunk part it rests on - needs the assembled MJCF clearance check)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off the z=19.2 plan cut and z-intervals, 2026-09-02
